Synopsis

“Team Leader, watching you all vulnerable and alone is pretty cute.” To other departments, she’s the ace female team leader who excels at her job. To her own team, she’s a temperamental boss who nags at them every morning. One day… Siwoo, who had left his phone in the restroom, ends up discovering his boss masturbating there. ‘Crazy bitch, haha… So you were just an animal in the end, huh?’

Pull Yourself Together, Team Leader (also known as 팀장님, 똑바로 서세요) is an ongoing Korean mature manhwa , written by Cocoball and illustrated by Cocoball.

It is also commonly searched as “Pull Yourself Together, Team Leader manga”, even though it follows the Korean manhwa/webtoon format. Readers who want to read Pull Yourself Together, Team Leader online in English can explore this series for its engaging plot, character-driven storytelling, and distinctive artwork.

Whether you search for Pull Yourself Together, Team Leader manhwa or Pull Yourself Together, Team Leader manga, it offers a strong reading experience within the mature genre.
